For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/i7 chip.

RAM: 16 GB is the minimum for running code editors, browsers and Docker together. Pick one that can be upgraded.
Storage: 512 GB SSD or more. Avoid anything with a hard disk.
Screen: Full HD or better, and a good keyboard. You'll look at both all day.
Battery: Aim for 8 hours or more of real use.
Graphics card: Skip it unless you plan to do game development or machine learning. That money is better spent on RAM and screen quality.

I haven't checked live prices, so I can't name exact AI yet. Tell me whether you do web, apps or machine learning work, and I can look up three real options and compare them.
